column4: Symbol
Content
Bits
SCHANN
This field contains the binary number, located at a half
word address, representing the channel number to which
the unit area is attached. The field is set by I-O assign-
ment and sometimes by I-O change and special assign-
ment. It is used by the actuator, receptor and I-O
change.
SUNITN
This field contains the binary number, located at a full
word address, representing the unit number to which
this unit area is attached. Setting and testing of this
field is the same as for SCHANN.
SIODK
This field specifies the number of IOD requests or file
area tables attached to the unit specified, as a binary
number, located at a full word address. The field is
set by I-O assignment.
SRMTC
Time of the last mount message.
SUUNAS
Unassign indicator
1 = already unassigned.
SRMIND
Remind bit:
0 - Mount reminder message not sent.
1 - Mount reminder message sent.
SEVLTB
This field specifies the base address of the evaluation
table for the pseudo-operation currently being processed
for the unit.
SEVLMK
This field contains the address of the evaluation mask for
the pseudo-operation currently being processed for the
unit. It is set and used by the actuator.
SFIAAC
This field specifies the address of the file area table
presently attached to the unit. It is set and used by the
actuator.
SCWADR
This field contains the address of the first control word
of a requested operation. It is set by the control word
checking routine in the actuator, and is used by the
actuator.
SRETRY
I-O instruction retry control bit. If 1, retry.
SREMNT
This indicator is set by the tape label verification
routine. It indicates to the verification routine whether
or not a problem program tape has failed to verify and
the operator has been informed.
0 - New tape not requested
1 - New tape requested
